title: Real Racing Save Not Working Properly
author: KarnFu
body:
### App DB report link

https://github.com/touchHLE/touchHLE/actions/runs/20005133382#artifacts

### App name

Real Racing

### App version

1.00

### touchHLE version

v0.2.2-997

### Operating system

Android 13

### GPU

Qualcomm

### What is the problem with the app?

Real Racing launches successfully on TouchHLE, but the game fails to load an existing saved profile. It either gets stuck on the loading screen or resets to a fresh profile instead of restoring previous progress.
